The manual (pageChange) output is removed; the currentPage two-way model already emits (currentPageChange) on every page change (including the reset to page 1 after a size change). Rename (pageChange)="..." to (currentPageChange)="..." on ds-pagination. (pageSizeChange) is UNCHANGED — it is now the pageSize model's implicit output, same name and payload; [(currentPage)] / [(pageSize)] two-way bindings need no change.

Removed (distinct from withAddonRight below — match the exact attribute; withAddon is a substring of withAddonRight). The flush-addon layout is now derived from the DOM: a boxed .addon projected into [dsInputPrefix] (…) sits flush automatically via :has(), and a bare keeps its inset. Delete the [withAddon] attribute — a boxed addon renders identically; a bare icon that used the flag regains its proper left inset (bugfix).
items.verify: No ds-input carries `withAddon`; a boxed addon projected into [dsInputPrefix] sits flush on its own.

items.note: Removed — the trailing counterpart of withAddon. A boxed .addon.right projected into [dsInputSuffix] now sits flush automatically via :has(). Delete the [withAddonRight] attribute.

Component renamed (shipped as ds-app-shell in the tagged 0.6.3 source). Behaviour unchanged — rename the element and its closing tag. Also rename the class, service and tokens (separate entries below).
The exported component class renamed alongside the ds-app-shell → ds-app-layout selector. Update imports / type references.
The exported scroll-to-top-on-navigation service renamed with the app-shell → app-layout rename. Update inject()/import references; the scrollToTop() API is unchanged.

Prefix rename for the four layout tokens: --ds-app-shell-pad-x / -pad-y / -content-max-width / -height → --ds-app-layout-*. DS-owned tokens only (no others ship under this prefix); a consumer's own --ds-app-shell-* variable is out of scope. Confirm the new name exists in the installed package.

ds-select's clear-x is now keyboard-operable: the trigger changed from <button role="combobox"> to <div role="combobox" tabindex="0">, and the clear affordance from a mouse-only <span aria-hidden> to a real <button aria-label="Clear selection">. Nothing stops compiling, but a consumer that targeted the old <button role=combobox> trigger or the <span> clear in CSS selectors or e2e/unit tests must retarget to the div / the button.
items.verify: No CSS selector or test targets the old <button role="combobox"> trigger or the <span> clear affordance - both are a div and a real button now.

items.note: Message-bearing fields (ds-input, ds-textarea, ds-select, ds-autocomplete, ds-multi-select, ds-checkbox, ds-radio, ds-radio-group, ds-switch, ds-slider, ds-otp-input, ds-date-picker, ds-time-picker, ds-color-picker) now reserve one message line of height by DEFAULT via the new reserveMessage input (default true). Was: the footer existed only when a hint/error/counter was present, so a field with no message was shorter and grew when a message first appeared. Purely visual — nothing stops compiling. To restore the old collapsing behaviour on a field, set [reserveMessage]="false". Review form vertical rhythm: the reserved row sits ~23px under the control, so tightly-stacked field pairs may read as a gap. (ds-search and ds-number-stepper have no message row and are NOT affected.)
items.verify: Form vertical rhythm was re-read with the reserved row present: a tightly stacked pair does not read as a gap.

items.note: Only affects a consumer that EXTENDS a DS component class. Subclassing is unsupported (design-system.md - Components), but where it happens this release can break the build the same way 0.6.3 did: TableComponent gained total, sortingOrder, animateHeight and scrollToTopOnPageChange, and most other component classes changed too, so a subclass that already used one of those names no longer compiles — TS4114 requires an 'override' modifier, TS2416 fires where the signature differs. Resolution per member: where the base member means the same thing, keep the name and add `override` with a base-compatible signature; otherwise RENAME the subclass's own member, checking the new name against the base's member list first. Build the consumer right after the bump: the compiler enumerates every collision. A consumer that only uses the DS elements needs no action.
items.verify: A typecheck reports no TS4114 / TS2416 on a TableComponent subclass; a kept `zebra` override adopts the base booleanAttribute transform.

informational: AvatarSize, ModalSize and ContainerSize are NOT removed — they remain and now extend DsSize ('xs' | DsSize, DsSize | 'xl' | 'fullscreen', DsSize | 'xl' | 'full'); no change needed for consumers using those three.

ds-avatar gains deterministic seeded tinting: [seed]/[avoidHues] inputs derive a stable per-person OKLCH background + auto-contrast text; standalone exports avatarTint(seed, options), AvatarTintOptions and initialsFrom(first, last) (also accepts a full-name string), and [tint] now also accepts 'neutral' — additive, off by default, no code change.

New override tokens --ds-sidenav-item-label-weight and --ds-modal-title-weight (previously baked into font: shorthands); defaults unchanged (--font-weight-semibold / --font-weight-bold) — additive, no code change.

ds-table gains opt-in inputs total (server-side paging: feed the full row count and pass one pre-sliced page), sortingOrder (e.g. ['asc','desc'] to drop the unsorted state), animateHeight (tween body height on a row-set change), scrollToTopOnPageChange, plus TableColumn.srLabel (visually-hidden header name) — all additive, off by default, no code change.
ds-search gains a size input (sm/md/lg); default md keeps the prior 36px height, so existing consumers are unaffected — additive, no code change.
ds-badge gains a countLabel input (default 'notifications') for the count's accessible-label noun — additive, no code change.

Bugfixes, no code change: --ds-avatar-size now applies at every size (not only md); ds-table clamps an out-of-range page after a client-side filter shrinks the result set; collapsed ds-sidenav no longer overflows by 1px; dsTooltip now listens on focusin/focusout so keyboard focus toggles the tip and re-rendered anchors no longer strand panels; stacked overlays (modal/drawer/bottom-sheet) no longer unlock body scroll under each other (shared ref-counted BodyScrollLockService).

ds-sidenav-item gains an optional (activate) output — emits the click MouseEvent; preventDefault() intercepts navigation on an href item, but a routerLink item navigates regardless. Additive, no code change.
BodyScrollLockService is now a public export — inject it to make a consumer's own full-screen overlay share the DS body-scroll lock (paired lock()/unlock()). Additive, no code change.

ds-menu: a disabled ds-menu-item is now keyboard-focusable (aria-disabled, kept in the roving/arrow/type-ahead order) instead of being dropped from nav and rendered as a native disabled button; activation stays blocked and a [dsTooltip] on it now shows on focus. Behavior/a11y only, no code change — but an e2e/unit test asserting a disabled menu item is unfocusable/native-disabled must be updated.
